description: Run TakeMeUp's one-click makeover on one of the user's CVs: rewrites it, checks ATS, aging, buzzwords and authenticity, and picks a template — saved as a NEW CV (the original stays). Takes 1–3 minutes; needs AI consent; daily limit (free 2, PRO 5). Use when the user wants the whole CV improved in one go. Returns the new CV id and before/after scores.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: run_takemeup_one_click_cv
title: One-click CV makeover
